import Mathlib

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal NNReal

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteConformal

def strictRank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter fun j => scores j < scores i).card

def badIndices {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : ι → ℝ) (rank : ℕ) : Finset ι :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun i => rank ≤ strictRank scores i

theorem strictRank_permute {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (p : Equiv.Perm ι) (i : ι) :
    strictRank (fun j => scores (p j)) i = strictRank scores (p i) := by
  classical
  unfold strictRank
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun j _ => p j)
  · intro j hj
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using hj
  · intro a _ b _ h
    exact p.injective h
  · intro b hb
    refine ⟨p.symm b,?_,by simp⟩
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,p.apply_symm_apply] using hb

theorem badIndices_card_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (rank : ℕ) :
    (badIndices scores rank).card ≤ Fintype.card ι-rank := by
  classical
  by_cases he : (badIndices scores rank).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨i,hi,hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image (badIndices scores rank) scores he
    have hk : rank ≤ strictRank scores i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hs : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => scores j < scores i) ⊆
        Finset.univ \ badIndices scores rank := by
      intro j hj
      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j,?_⟩
      intro hb
      have hji := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hij := hmin j hb
      linarith
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    have heq := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card
      (Finset.subset_univ (badIndices scores rank))
    rw [Finset.card_univ] at heq
    unfold strictRank at hk
    omega
  · have hz := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he
    simp [hz]

theorem measurable_strictRank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (i : ι) :
    Measurable (fun scores : ι → ℝ => strictRank scores i) := by
  classical
  unfold strictRank
  simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones,Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro j _
  exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt (measurable_pi_apply j) (measurable_pi_apply i))
    measurable_const measurable_const

theorem measurableSet_bad_rank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (i : ι) (rank : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {scores : ι → ℝ | rank ≤ strictRank scores i} :=
  measurableSet_le measurable_const (measurable_strictRank i)

theorem exchangeable_bad_rank_equal {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (p : Equiv.Perm ι) (i : ι) (rank : ℕ) :
    μ {ω | rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) (p i)} =
      μ {ω | rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) i} := by
  have h := (hex p).measure_mem_eq (measurableSet_bad_rank i rank)
  simpa only [preimage_ofPred_eq,strictRank_permute] using h

def badEvent {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ)
    (rank : ℕ) (i : ι) : Set Ω := {ω | rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) i}

theorem measurableSet_badEvent {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores) (rank : ℕ) (i : ι) :
    MeasurableSet (badEvent scores rank i) :=
  (measurableSet_bad_rank i rank).preimage hm

theorem bad_indicator_count {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (rank : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω) =
      ((badIndices (scores ω) rank).card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  simp only [badEvent,badIndices,Finset.card_eq_sum_ones,Nat.cast_sum,
    Finset.sum_filter,Nat.cast_ite,Nat.cast_one,Nat.cast_zero,Set.indicator,mem_ofPred_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases h : rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) i <;> simp only [h,if_true,if_false]

theorem sum_bad_probabilities_le {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores) (rank : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, μ.real (badEvent scores rank i)) ≤ (Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) := by
  classical
  have hInt : ∀ i, Integrable ((badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) μ :=
    fun i => (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_badEvent scores hm rank i)
  have hsum : (∫ ω, ∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, μ.real (badEvent scores rank i) := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hInt i)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using
      (integral_indicator_const (μ := μ) (1 : ℝ) (measurableSet_badEvent scores hm rank i))
  rw [← hsum]
  calc
    (∫ ω, ∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω ∂μ)
        ≤ ∫ _ω : Ω, ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hInt i)) (integrable_const _)
      intro ω
      change (∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω) ≤
        ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)
      rw [bad_indicator_count]
      exact_mod_cast badIndices_card_bound (scores ω) rank
    _ = _ := by simp

theorem exchangeable_rank_failure_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (i : ι) :
    μ.real (badEvent scores rank i) ≤
      ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have heach : ∀ j, μ.real (badEvent scores rank j)=μ.real (badEvent scores rank i) := by
    intro j
    have h := exchangeable_bad_rank_equal μ scores hex (Equiv.swap i j) i rank
    simpa only [Equiv.swap_apply_left,badEvent,Measure.real] using congrArg ENNReal.toReal h
  have hsum := sum_bad_probabilities_le μ scores hm rank
  simp only [heach,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hsum)

/-- The kth calibration order statistic, retaining ties and adding infinity
when k exceeds the available calibration sample. The minimum of maxima of
k-element index subsets is the kth value, without deleting duplicate scores. -/
def calibrationThreshold {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) : EReal := by
  classical
  exact ((Finset.univ.erase test).powersetCard rank).inf
    (fun subset => subset.sup (fun j => (scores j : EReal)))

theorem calibration_failure_iff {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test rank < (scores test : EReal) ↔
      rank ≤ strictRank scores test := by
  classical
  unfold calibrationThreshold
  rw [Finset.inf_lt_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨subset,hsub,hmax⟩
    have hcard := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hsub).2
    have hs : subset ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores test) := by
      intro j hj
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j,?_⟩
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (scores j : EReal)) hj) hmax)
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    simpa only [hcard,strictRank] using hc
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨subset,hsub,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq h
    refine ⟨subset,Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨?_,hcard⟩,?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      have hjlt := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub hj)).2
      have hne : j ≠ test := by intro he;rw [he] at hjlt;exact (lt_irrefl _) hjlt
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne,Finset.mem_univ j⟩
    · apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (EReal.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
      intro j hj
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr ((Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub hj)).2)

theorem unavailable_calibration_rank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) (h : Fintype.card ι-1 < rank) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test rank = ⊤ := by
  classical
  unfold calibrationThreshold
  have he : (Finset.univ.erase test).powersetCard rank=∅ := by
    rw [Finset.powersetCard_eq_empty,Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ test),Finset.card_univ]
    exact h
  rw [he,Finset.inf_empty]

theorem conformal_failure_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (test : ι) :
    μ.real {ω | calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank < (scores ω test : EReal)} ≤
      ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
  have he : {ω | calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank < (scores ω test : EReal)} =
      badEvent scores rank test := by
    ext ω
    exact calibration_failure_iff (scores ω) test rank
  rw [he]
  exact exchangeable_rank_failure_bound μ scores hm hex rank test

theorem conformal_success_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (test : ι) :
    1-((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≤
      μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤ calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank} := by
  have he : {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤ calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank} =
      (badEvent scores rank test)ᶜ := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq,mem_compl_iff,badEvent]
    rw [← calibration_failure_iff]
    exact not_lt.symm
  rw [he,probReal_compl_eq_one_sub (measurableSet_badEvent scores hm rank test)]
  linarith [exchangeable_rank_failure_bound μ scores hm hex rank test]

def conformalRank (sampleCount : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.ceil (((sampleCount+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*(1-alpha))

theorem conformalRank_le (n : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    conformalRank n alpha ≤ n+1 := by
  unfold conformalRank
  apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n+1 := by positivity
  push_cast
  nlinarith

theorem conformalRank_coverage_arithmetic (n : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    1-alpha ≤ 1-(((n+1-conformalRank n alpha : ℕ) : ℝ)/((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  have hle := conformalRank_le n alpha ha
  have hceil := Nat.le_ceil (((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*(1-alpha))
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
  apply sub_le_sub_left
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hpos).mpr
  change ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)-conformalRank n alpha ≤ alpha*((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  unfold conformalRank
  nlinarith

theorem split_conformal_coverage {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (n : ℕ) (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n+1)),
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (test : Fin (n+1)) :
    1-alpha ≤ μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test (conformalRank n alpha)} := by
  have h := conformal_success_bound μ scores hm hex (conformalRank n alpha) test
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  exact (conformalRank_coverage_arithmetic n alpha ha).trans h

  norm_num [conformalRank,Nat.ceil_eq_iff]

theorem rank_nineteen_one_percent : conformalRank 19 (1/100) = 20 := by
  norm_num [conformalRank,Nat.ceil_eq_iff]

theorem nineteen_calibration_coverage {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → Fin 20 → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 20),
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ) (test : Fin 20) :
    (9/10 : ℝ) ≤ μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test 18} := by
  have h := split_conformal_coverage 19 μ scores hm hex (1/10) (by norm_num) test

    calibrationThreshold scores test (conformalRank 19 (1/100)) = ⊤ := by
  rw [rank_nineteen_one_percent]
  exact unavailable_calibration_rank scores test 20 (by simp)

end SafeLearning.CompleteConformal

import Mathlib

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedConformalRanks
open Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators Topology

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- Zero-based strict rank of an actual coordinate among all finite scores. -/
def rankNat (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores index)).card

theorem actual_rank_is_less_than_sample_size (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) :
    rankNat scores index < n := by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores index) ⊂ Finset.univ := by
    refine ⟨Finset.filter_subset _ _,?_⟩
    intro hall
    have h := hall (Finset.mem_univ index)
    simp at h
  simpa [rankNat] using Finset.card_lt_card hs

def rankFin (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) : Fin n :=
  ⟨rankNat scores index,actual_rank_is_less_than_sample_size scores index⟩

theorem actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order
    (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (first second : Fin n) (h : scores first < scores second) :
    rankNat scores first < rankNat scores second := by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores first) ⊂
      Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores second) := by
    constructor
    · intro j hj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        lt_trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2 h⟩
    · intro hall
      have hi := hall (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ first,h⟩)
      simp at hi
  exact Finset.card_lt_card hs

theorem actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks (scores : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : Function.Injective scores) : Function.Bijective (rankFin scores) := by
  have hi : Function.Injective (rankFin scores) := by
    intro i j he
    have hv : rankNat scores i=rankNat scores j := congrArg Fin.val he
    by_contra hij
    have hs : scores i ≠ scores j := fun he => hij (h he)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hs with hs|hs
    · exact (ne_of_lt (actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order scores i j hs)) hv
    · exact (ne_of_lt (actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order scores j i hs)) hv.symm
  exact ⟨hi,(Finite.injective_iff_surjective).mp hi⟩

theorem actual_each_rank_occurs_exactly_once (scores : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : Function.Injective scores) (rank : Fin n) :
    (∑ i : Fin n,if rankNat scores i=rank.val then (1:ℝ) else 0)=1 := by
  obtain ⟨index,hi⟩ := (actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks scores h).2 rank
  have he : ∀ i : Fin n,rankNat scores i=rank.val ↔ i=index := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro ht
      apply (actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks scores h).1
      apply Fin.ext
      exact ht.trans (congrArg Fin.val hi).symm
    · intro ht
      subst i
      exact congrArg Fin.val hi
  simp_rw [he]
  simp

theorem actual_rank_is_measurable (index : Fin n) :
    Measurable (fun scores : Fin n → ℝ => rankNat scores index) := by
  have he : (fun scores : Fin n → ℝ => rankNat scores index)=
      (fun scores => ∑ j : Fin n,if scores j<scores index then (1:ℕ) else 0) := by
    funext scores
    simp [rankNat]
  rw [he]
  exact Finset.measurable_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ =>
    Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt (measurable_pi_apply j) (measurable_pi_apply index))
      measurable_const measurable_const)

def permutedScores (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (scores : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => scores (permutation i)

theorem actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    Measurable (permutedScores permutation) := by
  exact Measurable.of_eval (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (permutation i))

theorem actual_relabeling_preserves_the_corresponding_rank
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) :
    rankNat (permutedScores permutation scores) index=rankNat scores (permutation index) := by
  have hl : rankNat (permutedScores permutation scores) index=
      ∑ j : Fin n,if scores (permutation j)<scores (permutation index) then (1:ℕ) else 0 := by
    simp [rankNat,permutedScores]
    rfl
  rw [hl]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n,if scores j<scores (permutation index) then (1:ℕ) else 0 :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv permutation _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = _ := by simp [rankNat]

def rankEvent (index : Fin n) (rank : Fin n) : Set (Fin n → ℝ) :=
  {scores | rankNat scores index=rank.val}

theorem actual_rank_event_measurable (index rank : Fin n) : MeasurableSet (rankEvent index rank) :=
  (actual_rank_is_measurable index) (measurableSet_singleton rank.val)

/-- Exchangeability is invariance of the genuine joint score law under every
coordinate permutation, rather than an assumed uniform-rank conclusion. -/
def exchangeable (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),law.map (permutedScores permutation)=law

theorem actual_exchangeability_gives_equal_coordinate_rank_probabilities
    (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) (h : exchangeable law) (first second rank : Fin n) :
    law.real (rankEvent first rank)=law.real (rankEvent second rank) := by
  have hm := actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable (Equiv.swap first second)
  rw [←h (Equiv.swap first second),map_measureReal_apply hm (actual_rank_event_measurable first rank)]
  have he : permutedScores (Equiv.swap first second) ⁻¹' rankEvent first rank=rankEvent second rank := by
    ext scores
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage,rankEvent,Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [actual_relabeling_preserves_the_corresponding_rank,Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  rw [he,h (Equiv.swap first second)]

theorem actual_tie_free_exchangeable_rank_is_uniform
    (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : exchangeable law) (hties : ∀ᵐ scores ∂law,Function.Injective scores)
    (index rank : Fin n) : law.real (rankEvent index rank)=1/(n:ℝ) := by
  have hs : ∑ i : Fin n,law.real (rankEvent i rank)=1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin n,∫ scores,(rankEvent i rank).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) scores ∂law := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        symm
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using
          integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) (actual_rank_event_measurable i rank)
      _ = ∫ scores,∑ i : Fin n,(rankEvent i rank).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) scores ∂law := by
        symm
        apply integral_finsetSum
        intro i hi
        exact (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (actual_rank_event_measurable i rank)
      _ = ∫ _scores,1 ∂law := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hties] with scores hscore
        calc
          _ = ∑ i : Fin n,if rankNat scores i=rank.val then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            by_cases h : rankNat scores i=rank.val <;> simp [rankEvent,Set.indicator,h]
          _ = 1 := actual_each_rank_occurs_exactly_once scores hscore rank
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have he : ∑ i : Fin n,law.real (rankEvent i rank)=
      (n:ℝ)*law.real (rankEvent index rank) := by
    simp_rw [actual_exchangeability_gives_equal_coordinate_rank_probabilities law hex _ index rank]
    simp
  rw [he] at hs
  have hn : (n:ℝ)≠0 := by
    have hp : 0<n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt index.isLt
    exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
  apply (eq_div_iff hn).mpr
  nlinarith

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedConformalRanks

def strictRank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : ℕ :=

def badIndices {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : ι → ℝ) (rank : ℕ) : Finset ι :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun i => rank ≤ strictRank scores i

theorem strictRank_permute {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (p : Equiv.Perm ι) (i : ι) :
    strictRank (fun j => scores (p j)) i = strictRank scores (p i) := by

    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using hj
  · intro a _ b _ h
    exact p.injective h
  · intro b hb
    refine ⟨p.symm b,?_,by simp⟩
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,p.apply_symm_apply] using hb

    simp [hz]

    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)

    (fun subset => subset.sup (fun j => (scores j : EReal)))

theorem calibration_failure_iff {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test rank < (scores test : EReal) ↔
      rank ≤ strictRank scores test := by
  classical
  unfold calibrationThreshold
  rw [Finset.inf_lt_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨subset,hsub,hmax⟩
    have hcard := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hsub).2
    have hs : subset ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores test) := by
      intro j hj
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j,?_⟩
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (scores j : EReal)) hj) hmax)
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    simpa only [hcard,strictRank] using hc
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨subset,hsub,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq h
    refine ⟨subset,Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨?_,hcard⟩,?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      have hjlt := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub hj)).2
      have hne : j ≠ test := by intro he;rw [he] at hjlt;exact (lt_irrefl _) hjlt
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne,Finset.mem_univ j⟩
    · apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (EReal.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
      intro j hj
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr ((Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub hj)).2)

theorem unavailable_calibration_rank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) (h : Fintype.card ι-1 < rank) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test rank = ⊤ := by
  classical
  unfold calibrationThreshold
  have he : (Finset.univ.erase test).powersetCard rank=∅ := by
    rw [Finset.powersetCard_eq_empty,Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ test),Finset.card_univ]
    exact h
  rw [he,Finset.inf_empty]

theorem conformal_failure_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (test : ι) :
    μ.real {ω | calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank < (scores ω test : EReal)} ≤
      ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
  have he : {ω | calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank < (scores ω test : EReal)} =
      badEvent scores rank test := by
    ext ω
    exact calibration_failure_iff (scores ω) test rank
  rw [he]
  exact exchangeable_rank_failure_bound μ scores hm hex rank test

theorem conformal_success_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (test : ι) :
    1-((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≤
      μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤ calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank} := by
  have he : {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤ calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank} =
      (badEvent scores rank test)ᶜ := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq,mem_compl_iff,badEvent]
    rw [← calibration_failure_iff]
    exact not_lt.symm
  rw [he,probReal_compl_eq_one_sub (measurableSet_badEvent scores hm rank test)]
  linarith [exchangeable_rank_failure_bound μ scores hm hex rank test]

def conformalRank (sampleCount : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.ceil (((sampleCount+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*(1-alpha))

theorem conformalRank_le (n : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    conformalRank n alpha ≤ n+1 := by
  unfold conformalRank
  apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n+1 := by positivity
  push_cast
  nlinarith

theorem conformalRank_coverage_arithmetic (n : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    1-alpha ≤ 1-(((n+1-conformalRank n alpha : ℕ) : ℝ)/((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  have hle := conformalRank_le n alpha ha
  have hceil := Nat.le_ceil (((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*(1-alpha))
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
  apply sub_le_sub_left
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hpos).mpr
  change ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)-conformalRank n alpha ≤ alpha*((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  unfold conformalRank
  nlinarith

theorem split_conformal_coverage {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (n : ℕ) (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n+1)),
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (test : Fin (n+1)) :
    1-alpha ≤ μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test (conformalRank n alpha)} := by
  have h := conformal_success_bound μ scores hm hex (conformalRank n alpha) test
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  exact (conformalRank_coverage_arithmetic n alpha ha).trans h

theorem rank_nineteen_ten_percent : conformalRank 19 (1/10) = 18 := by
  norm_num [conformalRank,Nat.ceil_eq_iff]

theorem rank_nineteen_one_percent : conformalRank 19 (1/100) = 20 := by
  norm_num [conformalRank,Nat.ceil_eq_iff]

theorem nineteen_calibration_coverage {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → Fin 20 → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 20),
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ) (test : Fin 20) :
    (9/10 : ℝ) ≤ μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test 18} := by
  have h := split_conformal_coverage 19 μ scores hm hex (1/10) (by norm_num) test
  norm_num only [rank_nineteen_ten_percent] at h
  exact h

theorem nineteen_one_percent_infinite (scores : Fin 20 → ℝ) (test : Fin 20) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test (conformalRank 19 (1/100)) = ⊤ := by
  rw [rank_nineteen_one_percent]
  exact unavailable_calibration_rank scores test 20 (by simp)

end SafeLearning.CompleteConformal

theorem actual_source_label_objective_and_greatest_violation :

  · intro x; unfold labelViolation firstLogit secondLogit; ring
  · constructor
    · refine ⟨0,by norm_num,?_⟩

  refine ⟨by norm_num,by norm_num,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have h := (actual_source_label_objective_and_greatest_violation.2.1.2
      (show labelViolation x ∈ labelViolation '' Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 from ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩))

def nineSortedScores (i : Fin 10) : ℝ := (i.val+1 : ℝ)/10
def firstEight : Finset (Fin 10) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i.val<8)
def firstSeven : Finset (Fin 10) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i.val<7)

theorem actual_eighth_calibration_statistic_equals_point_eight :
    calibrationThreshold nineSortedScores 9 8=(4/5 : ℝ) := by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Fin 10) := Classical.decEq _
  unfold calibrationThreshold

      apply Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr
      constructor

        have hlt : i.val<8 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
        refine ⟨?_,Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        intro h;subst i;norm_num at hlt
      · decide
    calc
      _ ≤ firstEight.sup (fun i => (nineSortedScores i : EReal)) :=
        Finset.inf_le (f := fun s : Finset (Fin 10) =>
          s.sup (fun i => (nineSortedScores i : EReal))) hs

        apply Finset.sup_le
        intro i hi
        have hlt : i.val<8 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
        unfold nineSortedScores
        have hv : (i.val : ℝ) ≤ 7 := by exact_mod_cast (show i.val≤7 by omega)
        linarith
  · refine Finset.le_inf (f := fun s : Finset (Fin 10) =>
        s.sup (fun i => (nineSortedScores i : EReal))) ?_
    intro s hs
    have hc : s.card=8 := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hs).2
    have hsome : ∃ (i : Fin 10), i ∈ s ∧ (7 : ℕ) ≤ i.val := by
      by_contra hn
      push Not at hn
      have hsub : s ⊆ firstSeven := by
        intro i hi
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hn i hi⟩
      have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      have hseven : firstSeven.card=7 := by decide
      omega
    obtain ⟨i,hi,hv⟩ := hsome
    apply Finset.le_sup_of_le hi
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
    unfold nineSortedScores
    have hr : (7 : ℝ) ≤ i.val := by exact_mod_cast hv
    linarith

  refine ⟨?_,by norm_num [nineSortedScores],?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    unfold nineSortedScores

  · ext y

    constructor <;> rintro ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith

    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]

import Mathlib

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedConformalRanks
open Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators Topology

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- Zero-based strict rank of an actual coordinate among all finite scores. -/
def rankNat (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores index)).card

theorem actual_rank_is_less_than_sample_size (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) :
    rankNat scores index < n := by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores index) ⊂ Finset.univ := by
    refine ⟨Finset.filter_subset _ _,?_⟩
    intro hall
    have h := hall (Finset.mem_univ index)
    simp at h
  simpa [rankNat] using Finset.card_lt_card hs

def rankFin (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) : Fin n :=
  ⟨rankNat scores index,actual_rank_is_less_than_sample_size scores index⟩

theorem actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order
    (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (first second : Fin n) (h : scores first < scores second) :
    rankNat scores first < rankNat scores second := by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores first) ⊂
      Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores second) := by
    constructor
    · intro j hj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        lt_trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2 h⟩
    · intro hall
      have hi := hall (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ first,h⟩)
      simp at hi
  exact Finset.card_lt_card hs

theorem actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks (scores : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : Function.Injective scores) : Function.Bijective (rankFin scores) := by
  have hi : Function.Injective (rankFin scores) := by
    intro i j he
    have hv : rankNat scores i=rankNat scores j := congrArg Fin.val he
    by_contra hij
    have hs : scores i ≠ scores j := fun he => hij (h he)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hs with hs|hs
    · exact (ne_of_lt (actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order scores i j hs)) hv
    · exact (ne_of_lt (actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order scores j i hs)) hv.symm
  exact ⟨hi,(Finite.injective_iff_surjective).mp hi⟩

theorem actual_each_rank_occurs_exactly_once (scores : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : Function.Injective scores) (rank : Fin n) :
    (∑ i : Fin n,if rankNat scores i=rank.val then (1:ℝ) else 0)=1 := by
  obtain ⟨index,hi⟩ := (actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks scores h).2 rank
  have he : ∀ i : Fin n,rankNat scores i=rank.val ↔ i=index := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro ht
      apply (actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks scores h).1
      apply Fin.ext
      exact ht.trans (congrArg Fin.val hi).symm
    · intro ht
      subst i
      exact congrArg Fin.val hi
  simp_rw [he]
  simp

theorem actual_rank_is_measurable (index : Fin n) :
    Measurable (fun scores : Fin n → ℝ => rankNat scores index) := by
  have he : (fun scores : Fin n → ℝ => rankNat scores index)=
      (fun scores => ∑ j : Fin n,if scores j<scores index then (1:ℕ) else 0) := by
    funext scores
    simp [rankNat]
  rw [he]
  exact Finset.measurable_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ =>
    Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt (measurable_pi_apply j) (measurable_pi_apply index))
      measurable_const measurable_const)

def permutedScores (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (scores : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => scores (permutation i)

theorem actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    Measurable (permutedScores permutation) := by
  exact Measurable.of_eval (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (permutation i))

theorem actual_relabeling_preserves_the_corresponding_rank
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (scores : Fin n → ℝ) (index : Fin n) :
    rankNat (permutedScores permutation scores) index=rankNat scores (permutation index) := by
  have hl : rankNat (permutedScores permutation scores) index=
      ∑ j : Fin n,if scores (permutation j)<scores (permutation index) then (1:ℕ) else 0 := by
    simp [rankNat,permutedScores]
    rfl
  rw [hl]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n,if scores j<scores (permutation index) then (1:ℕ) else 0 :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv permutation _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = _ := by simp [rankNat]

def rankEvent (index : Fin n) (rank : Fin n) : Set (Fin n → ℝ) :=
  {scores | rankNat scores index=rank.val}

theorem actual_rank_event_measurable (index rank : Fin n) : MeasurableSet (rankEvent index rank) :=
  (actual_rank_is_measurable index) (measurableSet_singleton rank.val)

/-- Exchangeability is invariance of the genuine joint score law under every
coordinate permutation, rather than an assumed uniform-rank conclusion. -/
def exchangeable (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),law.map (permutedScores permutation)=law

theorem actual_exchangeability_gives_equal_coordinate_rank_probabilities
    (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) (h : exchangeable law) (first second rank : Fin n) :
    law.real (rankEvent first rank)=law.real (rankEvent second rank) := by
  have hm := actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable (Equiv.swap first second)
  rw [←h (Equiv.swap first second),map_measureReal_apply hm (actual_rank_event_measurable first rank)]
  have he : permutedScores (Equiv.swap first second) ⁻¹' rankEvent first rank=rankEvent second rank := by
    ext scores
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage,rankEvent,Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [actual_relabeling_preserves_the_corresponding_rank,Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  rw [he,h (Equiv.swap first second)]

theorem actual_tie_free_exchangeable_rank_is_uniform
    (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : exchangeable law) (hties : ∀ᵐ scores ∂law,Function.Injective scores)
    (index rank : Fin n) : law.real (rankEvent index rank)=1/(n:ℝ) := by
  have hs : ∑ i : Fin n,law.real (rankEvent i rank)=1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin n,∫ scores,(rankEvent i rank).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) scores ∂law := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        symm
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using
          integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) (actual_rank_event_measurable i rank)
      _ = ∫ scores,∑ i : Fin n,(rankEvent i rank).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) scores ∂law := by
        symm
        apply integral_finsetSum
        intro i hi
        exact (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (actual_rank_event_measurable i rank)
      _ = ∫ _scores,1 ∂law := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hties] with scores hscore
        calc
          _ = ∑ i : Fin n,if rankNat scores i=rank.val then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            by_cases h : rankNat scores i=rank.val <;> simp [rankEvent,Set.indicator,h]
          _ = 1 := actual_each_rank_occurs_exactly_once scores hscore rank
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have he : ∑ i : Fin n,law.real (rankEvent i rank)=
      (n:ℝ)*law.real (rankEvent index rank) := by
    simp_rw [actual_exchangeability_gives_equal_coordinate_rank_probabilities law hex _ index rank]
    simp
  rw [he] at hs
  have hn : (n:ℝ)≠0 := by
    have hp : 0<n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt index.isLt
    exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
  apply (eq_div_iff hn).mpr
  nlinarith

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedConformalRanks

import Mathlib

set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal NNReal

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteConformal

def strictRank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter fun j => scores j < scores i).card

def badIndices {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : ι → ℝ) (rank : ℕ) : Finset ι :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun i => rank ≤ strictRank scores i

theorem strictRank_permute {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (p : Equiv.Perm ι) (i : ι) :
    strictRank (fun j => scores (p j)) i = strictRank scores (p i) := by
  classical
  unfold strictRank
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun j _ => p j)
  · intro j hj
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using hj
  · intro a _ b _ h
    exact p.injective h
  · intro b hb
    refine ⟨p.symm b,?_,by simp⟩
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,p.apply_symm_apply] using hb

theorem badIndices_card_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (rank : ℕ) :
    (badIndices scores rank).card ≤ Fintype.card ι-rank := by
  classical
  by_cases he : (badIndices scores rank).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨i,hi,hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image (badIndices scores rank) scores he
    have hk : rank ≤ strictRank scores i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hs : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => scores j < scores i) ⊆
        Finset.univ \ badIndices scores rank := by
      intro j hj
      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j,?_⟩
      intro hb
      have hji := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hij := hmin j hb
      linarith
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    have heq := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card
      (Finset.subset_univ (badIndices scores rank))
    rw [Finset.card_univ] at heq
    unfold strictRank at hk
    omega
  · have hz := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he
    simp [hz]

theorem measurable_strictRank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (i : ι) :
    Measurable (fun scores : ι → ℝ => strictRank scores i) := by
  classical
  unfold strictRank
  simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones,Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro j _
  exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt (measurable_pi_apply j) (measurable_pi_apply i))
    measurable_const measurable_const

theorem measurableSet_bad_rank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (i : ι) (rank : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {scores : ι → ℝ | rank ≤ strictRank scores i} :=
  measurableSet_le measurable_const (measurable_strictRank i)

theorem exchangeable_bad_rank_equal {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (p : Equiv.Perm ι) (i : ι) (rank : ℕ) :
    μ {ω | rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) (p i)} =
      μ {ω | rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) i} := by
  have h := (hex p).measure_mem_eq (measurableSet_bad_rank i rank)
  simpa only [preimage_ofPred_eq,strictRank_permute] using h

def badEvent {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ)
    (rank : ℕ) (i : ι) : Set Ω := {ω | rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) i}

theorem measurableSet_badEvent {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores) (rank : ℕ) (i : ι) :
    MeasurableSet (badEvent scores rank i) :=
  (measurableSet_bad_rank i rank).preimage hm

theorem bad_indicator_count {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (rank : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω) =
      ((badIndices (scores ω) rank).card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  simp only [badEvent,badIndices,Finset.card_eq_sum_ones,Nat.cast_sum,
    Finset.sum_filter,Nat.cast_ite,Nat.cast_one,Nat.cast_zero,Set.indicator,mem_ofPred_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases h : rank ≤ strictRank (scores ω) i <;> simp only [h,if_true,if_false]

theorem sum_bad_probabilities_le {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores) (rank : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, μ.real (badEvent scores rank i)) ≤ (Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) := by
  classical
  have hInt : ∀ i, Integrable ((badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) μ :=
    fun i => (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_badEvent scores hm rank i)
  have hsum : (∫ ω, ∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, μ.real (badEvent scores rank i) := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hInt i)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using
      (integral_indicator_const (μ := μ) (1 : ℝ) (measurableSet_badEvent scores hm rank i))
  rw [← hsum]
  calc
    (∫ ω, ∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω ∂μ)
        ≤ ∫ _ω : Ω, ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hInt i)) (integrable_const _)
      intro ω
      change (∑ i, (badEvent scores rank i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω) ≤
        ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)
      rw [bad_indicator_count]
      exact_mod_cast badIndices_card_bound (scores ω) rank
    _ = _ := by simp

theorem exchangeable_rank_failure_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (i : ι) :
    μ.real (badEvent scores rank i) ≤
      ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have heach : ∀ j, μ.real (badEvent scores rank j)=μ.real (badEvent scores rank i) := by
    intro j
    have h := exchangeable_bad_rank_equal μ scores hex (Equiv.swap i j) i rank
    simpa only [Equiv.swap_apply_left,badEvent,Measure.real] using congrArg ENNReal.toReal h
  have hsum := sum_bad_probabilities_le μ scores hm rank
  simp only [heach,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hsum)

/-- The kth calibration order statistic, retaining ties and adding infinity
when k exceeds the available calibration sample. The minimum of maxima of
k-element index subsets is the kth value, without deleting duplicate scores. -/
def calibrationThreshold {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) : EReal := by
  classical
  exact ((Finset.univ.erase test).powersetCard rank).inf
    (fun subset => subset.sup (fun j => (scores j : EReal)))

theorem calibration_failure_iff {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test rank < (scores test : EReal) ↔
      rank ≤ strictRank scores test := by
  classical
  unfold calibrationThreshold
  rw [Finset.inf_lt_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨subset,hsub,hmax⟩
    have hcard := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hsub).2
    have hs : subset ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores test) := by
      intro j hj
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j,?_⟩
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (scores j : EReal)) hj) hmax)
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    simpa only [hcard,strictRank] using hc
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨subset,hsub,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq h
    refine ⟨subset,Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨?_,hcard⟩,?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      have hjlt := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub hj)).2
      have hne : j ≠ test := by intro he;rw [he] at hjlt;exact (lt_irrefl _) hjlt
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne,Finset.mem_univ j⟩
    · apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (EReal.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
      intro j hj
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr ((Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub hj)).2)

theorem unavailable_calibration_rank {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) (rank : ℕ) (h : Fintype.card ι-1 < rank) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test rank = ⊤ := by
  classical
  unfold calibrationThreshold
  have he : (Finset.univ.erase test).powersetCard rank=∅ := by
    rw [Finset.powersetCard_eq_empty,Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ test),Finset.card_univ]
    exact h
  rw [he,Finset.inf_empty]

theorem conformal_failure_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (test : ι) :
    μ.real {ω | calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank < (scores ω test : EReal)} ≤
      ((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
  have he : {ω | calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank < (scores ω test : EReal)} =
      badEvent scores rank test := by
    ext ω
    exact calibration_failure_iff (scores ω) test rank
  rw [he]
  exact exchangeable_rank_failure_bound μ scores hm hex rank test

theorem conformal_success_bound {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm ι,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (rank : ℕ) (test : ι) :
    1-((Fintype.card ι-rank : ℕ) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≤
      μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤ calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank} := by
  have he : {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤ calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test rank} =
      (badEvent scores rank test)ᶜ := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq,mem_compl_iff,badEvent]
    rw [← calibration_failure_iff]
    exact not_lt.symm
  rw [he,probReal_compl_eq_one_sub (measurableSet_badEvent scores hm rank test)]
  linarith [exchangeable_rank_failure_bound μ scores hm hex rank test]

def conformalRank (sampleCount : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.ceil (((sampleCount+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*(1-alpha))

theorem conformalRank_le (n : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    conformalRank n alpha ≤ n+1 := by
  unfold conformalRank
  apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n+1 := by positivity
  push_cast
  nlinarith

theorem conformalRank_coverage_arithmetic (n : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    1-alpha ≤ 1-(((n+1-conformalRank n alpha : ℕ) : ℝ)/((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  have hle := conformalRank_le n alpha ha
  have hceil := Nat.le_ceil (((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*(1-alpha))
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
  apply sub_le_sub_left
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hpos).mpr
  change ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)-conformalRank n alpha ≤ alpha*((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  unfold conformalRank
  nlinarith

theorem split_conformal_coverage {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (n : ℕ) (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n+1)),
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ)
    (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (test : Fin (n+1)) :
    1-alpha ≤ μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test (conformalRank n alpha)} := by
  have h := conformal_success_bound μ scores hm hex (conformalRank n alpha) test
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  exact (conformalRank_coverage_arithmetic n alpha ha).trans h

theorem rank_nineteen_ten_percent : conformalRank 19 (1/10) = 18 := by
  norm_num [conformalRank,Nat.ceil_eq_iff]

theorem rank_nineteen_one_percent : conformalRank 19 (1/100) = 20 := by
  norm_num [conformalRank,Nat.ceil_eq_iff]

theorem nineteen_calibration_coverage {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (scores : Ω → Fin 20 → ℝ) (hm : Measurable scores)
    (hex : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 20),
      IdentDistrib (fun ω i => scores ω (p i)) scores μ μ) (test : Fin 20) :
    (9/10 : ℝ) ≤ μ.real {ω | (scores ω test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (scores ω) test 18} := by
  have h := split_conformal_coverage 19 μ scores hm hex (1/10) (by norm_num) test
  norm_num only [rank_nineteen_ten_percent] at h
  exact h

theorem nineteen_one_percent_infinite (scores : Fin 20 → ℝ) (test : Fin 20) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test (conformalRank 19 (1/100)) = ⊤ := by
  rw [rank_nineteen_one_percent]
  exact unavailable_calibration_rank scores test 20 (by simp)

end SafeLearning.CompleteConformal

theorem actual_full_calibration_rank_is_the_finite_calibration_supremum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (scores : ι → ℝ) (test : ι) :
    calibrationThreshold scores test (Fintype.card ι - 1) =
      (Finset.univ.erase test).sup (fun i => (scores i : EReal)) := by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq ι := Classical.decEq _
  unfold calibrationThreshold
  have hc : (Finset.univ.erase test).card = Fintype.card ι - 1 := by simp
  rw [← hc, Finset.powersetCard_self, Finset.inf_singleton]

theorem actual_thirty_nine_calibration_threshold_is_an_attained_real_maximum
    (scores : Fin 40 → ℝ) (test : Fin 40) :
    ∃ i : Fin 40, i ≠ test ∧
      IsGreatest (scores '' {j | j ≠ test}) (scores i) ∧
      calibrationThreshold scores test 39 = (scores i : EReal) := by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Fin 40) := Classical.decEq _
  let s : Finset (Fin 40) := Finset.univ.erase test
  have hc : s.card = 39 := by simp [s]
  have hn : s.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hm⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup s hn (fun j => (scores j : EReal))
  have hit : i ≠ test := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1
  refine ⟨i, hit, ⟨⟨i,hit,rfl⟩,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · rintro y ⟨j,hjt,rfl⟩
    have hj : j ∈ s := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hjt,Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    have hle := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (scores j : EReal)) hj
    rw [hm] at hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hle
  · have h := actual_full_calibration_rank_is_the_finite_calibration_supremum scores test
    norm_num at h
    exact h.trans hm

def secondLogit (x : ℝ) : ℝ := -x+2

Exchangeability means the joint law is invariant under permutations, so $\mathbb P(\rho=r)$ is the same for every $r\in\{1,\dots,n+1\}$, hence $1/(n+1)$. The event $s_{n+1}\le s_{(k)}$ (the $k$-th smallest of the other $n$ scores) means that at most $k-1$ of the others are smaller than $s_{n+1}$, i.e. $\rho\le k$. Therefore $\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)=\mathbb P(\rho\le k)=k/(n+1)$.

The pairs are exchangeable and almost surely distinct, so by (a) the rank $\rho$ of the test pair satisfies $\mathbb P(\rho\le k)=k/(n+1)$. If $\rho\le k$, at most $k-1$ calibration pairs precede the test pair, so at most $k-1$ calibration scores are strictly smaller than $s_{n+1}$ and $s_{n+1}\le s_{(k)}=\hat q$. theorem actual_tie_free_joint_exchangeability_gives_every_rank_cdf
    (n : ℕ) (law : Measure (Fin (n+1) → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : exchangeable law) (hties : ∀ᵐ scores ∂law, Function.Injective scores)
    (test : Fin (n+1)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    law.real {scores | rankNat scores test < k} = (k : ℝ)/(n+1) := by
  classical
  let top : Fin (n+1) := ⟨k,by omega⟩
  let ranks : Finset (Fin (n+1)) := Finset.Iio top
  have he : {scores | rankNat scores test < k} =
      ⋃ r ∈ ranks, rankEvent test r := by
    ext scores
    constructor
    · intro hs
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨rankFin scores test,Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨?_,?_⟩⟩
      · simpa [ranks,top,Fin.lt_def,rankFin] using hs
      · rfl
    · intro hs
      obtain ⟨r,hs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hs
      obtain ⟨hr,he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hs
      have hlt : r.val < k := by simpa [ranks,top,Fin.lt_def] using hr
      change rankNat scores test = r.val at he
      change rankNat scores test < k
      rw [he]
      exact hlt
  have hd : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑ranks) (rankEvent test) := by
    intro r hr s hs hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro scores h1 h2
    apply hne
    apply Fin.ext
    change rankNat scores test = r.val at h1
    change rankNat scores test = s.val at h2
    exact h1.symm.trans h2
  rw [he,measureReal_biUnion_finset hd (fun r _ => actual_rank_event_measurable test r)]
  simp_rw [actual_tie_free_exchangeable_rank_is_uniform law hex hties test]
  simp [ranks,top,Fin.card_Iio,div_eq_mul_inv]

    {n : ℕ} (scores : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (test : Fin (n+1)) (k : ℕ) :

theorem actual_tie_free_split_calibration_coverage_is_exact
    (n : ℕ) (law : Measure (Fin (n+1) → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : exchangeable law) (hties : ∀ᵐ scores ∂law,Function.Injective scores)
    (test : Fin (n+1)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    law.real {scores | (scores test : EReal) ≤ calibrationThreshold scores test k} =

theorem actual_ceiling_rank_has_the_literal_two_sided_coverage_arithmetic

    1-alpha ≤ (conformalRank n alpha : ℝ)/(n+1) ∧
      (conformalRank n alpha : ℝ)/(n+1) < 1-alpha+1/(n+1) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℝ)<n+1 := by positivity

  have hhi := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ)≤((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr ha))
  simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] at hlo hhi
  constructor
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
    change (1-alpha)*(n+1) ≤ (Nat.ceil ((n+1 : ℝ)*(1-alpha)) : ℝ)
    nlinarith
  · apply (div_lt_iff₀ hp).mpr
    have hdiv : (1/(n+1 : ℝ))*(n+1)=1 := by field_simp [hp.ne']
    change (Nat.ceil ((n+1 : ℝ)*(1-alpha)) : ℝ)<(1-alpha+1/(n+1))*(n+1)
    nlinarith

    (scores : Fin 10 → ℝ) (test : Fin 10) :
    ∃ i : Fin 10, i ≠ test ∧
      IsGreatest (scores '' {j | j ≠ test}) (scores i) ∧
      calibrationThreshold scores test 9 = (scores i : EReal) := by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Fin 10) := Classical.decEq (Fin 10)
  let s : Finset (Fin 10) := Finset.univ.erase test
  have hc : s.card = 9 := by simp [s]
  have hn : s.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hm⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup s hn (fun j => (scores j : EReal))
  have hit : i ≠ test := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1
  refine ⟨i,hit,⟨⟨i,hit,rfl⟩,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · rintro y ⟨j,hjt,rfl⟩
    have hj : j ∈ s := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hjt,Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    have hle := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (scores j : EReal)) hj
    rw [hm] at hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hle
  · unfold calibrationThreshold
    change ((Finset.univ.erase test).powersetCard 9).inf
      (fun subset => subset.sup (fun j => (scores j : EReal))) = (scores i : EReal)
    rw [←hc,Finset.powersetCard_self,Finset.inf_singleton]
    exact hm

theorem actual_tie_free_split_calibration_has_both_literal_coverage_bounds
    (n : ℕ) (law : Measure (Fin (n+1) → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : exchangeable law) (hties : ∀ᵐ scores ∂law,Function.Injective scores)
    (test : Fin (n+1)) (alpha : ℝ) (ha : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hk : conformalRank n alpha ≤ n) :
    1-alpha ≤ law.real {scores | (scores test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold scores test (conformalRank n alpha)} ∧
    law.real {scores | (scores test : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold scores test (conformalRank n alpha)} <
        1-alpha+1/(n+1) := by
  rw [actual_tie_free_split_calibration_coverage_is_exact n law hex hties test
    (conformalRank n alpha) hk]
  exact actual_ceiling_rank_has_the_literal_two_sided_coverage_arithmetic n alpha ha

theorem actual_constant_nine_calibration_scores_are_always_covered_and_break_the_strict_upper
    (law : Measure (Fin 10 → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law] (test : Fin 10) :
    law.real {scores | ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (fun _ : Fin 10 => (0 : ℝ)) test 9} = 1 ∧
    ¬ (law.real {scores | ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) ≤
      calibrationThreshold (fun _ : Fin 10 => (0 : ℝ)) test 9} <
        1-(1/10 : ℝ)+1/10) := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hgreat,hthreshold⟩ :=
    actual_nine_calibration_threshold_is_an_attained_real_maximum (fun _ => 0) test
  have he : calibrationThreshold (fun _ : Fin 10 => (0 : ℝ)) test 9 = (0 : ℝ) := by
    simpa using hthreshold
  simp [he]

variable {n : ℕ}

abbrev PairScore := ℝ ×ₗ ℝ
instance : MeasurableSpace PairScore := inferInstanceAs (MeasurableSpace (ℝ × ℝ))
instance : MeasurableEq PairScore := inferInstanceAs (MeasurableEq (ℝ × ℝ))

theorem actual_lexicographic_comparison_is_measurable (j index : Fin n) :
    MeasurableSet {scores : Fin n → PairScore | scores j < scores index} := by
  have hf (i : Fin n) : Measurable (fun scores : Fin n → PairScore => (scores i).1) :=
    measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hs (i : Fin n) : Measurable (fun scores : Fin n → PairScore => (scores i).2) :=
    measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  simp only [Prod.Lex.lt_iff]
  exact (measurableSet_lt (hf j) (hf index)).union
    ((measurableSet_eq_fun (hf j) (hf index)).inter
      (measurableSet_lt (hs j) (hs index)))

/-- Zero-based strict rank of an actual coordinate among all finite scores. -/
def rankNat (scores : Fin n → PairScore) (index : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores index)).card

theorem actual_rank_is_less_than_sample_size (scores : Fin n → PairScore) (index : Fin n) :
    rankNat scores index < n := by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores index) ⊂ Finset.univ := by
    refine ⟨Finset.filter_subset _ _,?_⟩
    intro hall
    have h := hall (Finset.mem_univ index)
    simp at h
  simpa [rankNat] using Finset.card_lt_card hs

def rankFin (scores : Fin n → PairScore) (index : Fin n) : Fin n :=
  ⟨rankNat scores index,actual_rank_is_less_than_sample_size scores index⟩

theorem actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order
    (scores : Fin n → PairScore) (first second : Fin n) (h : scores first < scores second) :
    rankNat scores first < rankNat scores second := by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores first) ⊂
      Finset.univ.filter (fun j => scores j < scores second) := by
    constructor
    · intro j hj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        lt_trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2 h⟩
    · intro hall
      have hi := hall (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ first,h⟩)
      simp at hi
  exact Finset.card_lt_card hs

theorem actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks (scores : Fin n → PairScore)
    (h : Function.Injective scores) : Function.Bijective (rankFin scores) := by
  have hi : Function.Injective (rankFin scores) := by
    intro i j he
    have hv : rankNat scores i=rankNat scores j := congrArg Fin.val he
    by_contra hij
    have hs : scores i ≠ scores j := fun he => hij (h he)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hs with hs|hs
    · exact (ne_of_lt (actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order scores i j hs)) hv
    · exact (ne_of_lt (actual_strict_score_order_gives_strict_rank_order scores j i hs)) hv.symm
  exact ⟨hi,(Finite.injective_iff_surjective).mp hi⟩

theorem actual_each_rank_occurs_exactly_once (scores : Fin n → PairScore)
    (h : Function.Injective scores) (rank : Fin n) :
    (∑ i : Fin n,if rankNat scores i=rank.val then (1:ℝ) else 0)=1 := by
  obtain ⟨index,hi⟩ := (actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks scores h).2 rank
  have he : ∀ i : Fin n,rankNat scores i=rank.val ↔ i=index := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro ht
      apply (actual_distinct_scores_have_bijective_ranks scores h).1
      apply Fin.ext
      exact ht.trans (congrArg Fin.val hi).symm
    · intro ht
      subst i
      exact congrArg Fin.val hi
  simp_rw [he]
  simp

theorem actual_rank_is_measurable (index : Fin n) :
    Measurable (fun scores : Fin n → PairScore => rankNat scores index) := by
  have he : (fun scores : Fin n → PairScore => rankNat scores index)=
      (fun scores => ∑ j : Fin n,if scores j<scores index then (1:ℕ) else 0) := by
    funext scores
    simp [rankNat]
  rw [he]
  exact Finset.measurable_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ =>
    Measurable.ite (actual_lexicographic_comparison_is_measurable j index)
      measurable_const measurable_const)

def permutedScores (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (scores : Fin n → PairScore) : Fin n → PairScore :=
  fun i => scores (permutation i)

theorem actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    Measurable (permutedScores permutation) := by
  exact Measurable.of_eval (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (permutation i))

theorem actual_relabeling_preserves_the_corresponding_rank
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (scores : Fin n → PairScore) (index : Fin n) :
    rankNat (permutedScores permutation scores) index=rankNat scores (permutation index) := by
  have hl : rankNat (permutedScores permutation scores) index=
      ∑ j : Fin n,if scores (permutation j)<scores (permutation index) then (1:ℕ) else 0 := by
    simp [rankNat,permutedScores]
    rfl
  rw [hl]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n,if scores j<scores (permutation index) then (1:ℕ) else 0 :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv permutation _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = _ := by simp [rankNat]

def rankEvent (index : Fin n) (rank : Fin n) : Set (Fin n → PairScore) :=
  {scores | rankNat scores index=rank.val}

theorem actual_rank_event_measurable (index rank : Fin n) : MeasurableSet (rankEvent index rank) :=
  (actual_rank_is_measurable index) (measurableSet_singleton rank.val)

/-- Exchangeability is invariance of the genuine joint score law under every
coordinate permutation, rather than an assumed uniform-rank conclusion. -/
def exchangeable (law : Measure (Fin n → PairScore)) : Prop :=
  ∀ permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),law.map (permutedScores permutation)=law

theorem actual_exchangeability_gives_equal_coordinate_rank_probabilities
    (law : Measure (Fin n → PairScore)) (h : exchangeable law) (first second rank : Fin n) :
    law.real (rankEvent first rank)=law.real (rankEvent second rank) := by
  have hm := actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable (Equiv.swap first second)
  rw [←h (Equiv.swap first second),map_measureReal_apply hm (actual_rank_event_measurable first rank)]
  have he : permutedScores (Equiv.swap first second) ⁻¹' rankEvent first rank=rankEvent second rank := by
    ext scores
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage,rankEvent,Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [actual_relabeling_preserves_the_corresponding_rank,Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  rw [he,h (Equiv.swap first second)]

theorem actual_tie_free_exchangeable_rank_is_uniform
    (law : Measure (Fin n → PairScore)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : exchangeable law) (hties : ∀ᵐ scores ∂law,Function.Injective scores)
    (index rank : Fin n) : law.real (rankEvent index rank)=1/(n:ℝ) := by
  have hs : ∑ i : Fin n,law.real (rankEvent i rank)=1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin n,∫ scores,(rankEvent i rank).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) scores ∂law := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        symm
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using
          integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) (actual_rank_event_measurable i rank)
      _ = ∫ scores,∑ i : Fin n,(rankEvent i rank).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) scores ∂law := by
        symm
        apply integral_finsetSum
        intro i hi
        exact (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (actual_rank_event_measurable i rank)
      _ = ∫ _scores,1 ∂law := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hties] with scores hscore
        calc
          _ = ∑ i : Fin n,if rankNat scores i=rank.val then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            by_cases h : rankNat scores i=rank.val <;> simp [rankEvent,Set.indicator,h]
          _ = 1 := actual_each_rank_occurs_exactly_once scores hscore rank
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have he : ∑ i : Fin n,law.real (rankEvent i rank)=
      (n:ℝ)*law.real (rankEvent index rank) := by
    simp_rw [actual_exchangeability_gives_equal_coordinate_rank_probabilities law hex _ index rank]
    simp
  rw [he] at hs
  have hn : (n:ℝ)≠0 := by
    have hp : 0<n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt index.isLt
    exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
  apply (eq_div_iff hn).mpr
  nlinarith


open ProbabilityTheory

def uniformUnitSeed : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Icc 0 1)

instance actual_unit_uniform_seed_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure uniformUnitSeed := by
  apply isProbabilityMeasure_iff.mpr
  rw [uniformUnitSeed,Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
  norm_num

instance actual_unit_uniform_seed_has_no_atoms : NullSingletonClass uniformUnitSeed := by
  unfold uniformUnitSeed
  infer_instance

def independentSeedLaw (nu : Measure ℝ) : Measure (Fin n → ℝ) :=
  Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => nu)

instance actual_independent_seed_probability (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (independentSeedLaw (n := n) nu) := by
  unfold independentSeedLaw
  infer_instance

def attachSeeds (data : (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) : Fin n → PairScore :=
  fun i => (data.1 i,data.2 i)

theorem actual_attached_seed_pairs_are_measurable :
    Measurable (attachSeeds (n := n)) := by
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro i
  exact ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_fst).prodMk
    ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd)

theorem actual_iid_seed_law_is_invariant_under_permutations
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (independentSeedLaw nu).map
      (CompleteAppliedConformalRanks.permutedScores permutation) = independentSeedLaw nu := by
  have hp := measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (α := fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)
    (fun _ : Fin n => nu) permutation.symm
  change (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => nu)).map (fun f i => f (permutation i)) =
    Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => nu)
  simpa [MeasurableEquiv.coe_piCongrLeft,Equiv.piCongrLeft,Equiv.piCongrLeft'] using hp.map_eq

theorem actual_two_independent_atomless_seed_coordinates_cannot_tie
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [NullSingletonClass nu]
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    independentSeedLaw nu {seeds | seeds i = seeds j} = 0 := by
  have hi : iIndepFun (fun i : Fin n => fun seeds : Fin n → ℝ => seeds i)
      (independentSeedLaw nu) := by
    exact iIndepFun_pi (fun _ : Fin n => (measurable_id : Measurable (id : ℝ → ℝ)).aemeasurable)
  have hm := (hi.indepFun hij).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    (measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable (measurable_pi_apply j).aemeasurable
  change (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => nu)).map (fun seeds => (seeds i,seeds j)) = _ at hm
  change _ = ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => nu)).map (Function.eval i)).prod
    ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => nu)).map (Function.eval j)) at hm
  rw [(measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => nu) i).map_eq,
    (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => nu) j).map_eq] at hm
  have hd : (nu.prod nu) {pair : ℝ × ℝ | pair.1 = pair.2} = 0 := by
    apply (Measure.measure_prod_null (measurableSet_eq_fun measurable_fst measurable_snd)).2
    filter_upwards [] with x
    simp
  calc
    independentSeedLaw nu {seeds | seeds i = seeds j} =
        ((independentSeedLaw nu).map (fun seeds => (seeds i,seeds j)))
          {pair : ℝ × ℝ | pair.1 = pair.2} := by
      rw [Measure.map_apply ((measurable_pi_apply i).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply j))
        (measurableSet_eq_fun measurable_fst measurable_snd)]
      rfl
    _ = _ := by unfold independentSeedLaw;rw [hm,hd]

theorem actual_all_independent_atomless_seed_coordinates_are_distinct
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [NullSingletonClass nu] :
    ∀ᵐ seeds ∂independentSeedLaw (n := n) nu, Function.Injective seeds := by
  have hpair : ∀ i j : Fin n, ∀ᵐ seeds ∂independentSeedLaw nu,
      i ≠ j → seeds i ≠ seeds j := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp [hij]
    · have hn := actual_two_independent_atomless_seed_coordinates_cannot_tie nu i j hij
      have ha : ∀ᵐ seeds ∂independentSeedLaw nu, seeds i ≠ seeds j := by
        exact (compl_mem_ae_iff).2 hn
      filter_upwards [ha] with seeds hs
      exact fun _ => hs
  have hall : ∀ᵐ seeds ∂independentSeedLaw nu, ∀ i j : Fin n,
      i ≠ j → seeds i ≠ seeds j :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (hpair i))
  filter_upwards [hall] with seeds hs
  intro i j he
  by_contra hij
  exact hs i j hij he

def actualSeededPairLaw (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) (nu : Measure ℝ) :
    Measure (Fin n → PairScore) := (law.prod (independentSeedLaw nu)).map attachSeeds

theorem actual_independent_seed_attachment_preserves_joint_exchangeability
    (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) (nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure law] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hex : CompleteAppliedConformalRanks.exchangeable law) :
    exchangeable (actualSeededPairLaw law nu) := by
  intro permutation
  let perm := CompleteAppliedConformalRanks.permutedScores permutation
  have hm : Measurable perm := CompleteAppliedConformalRanks.actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable permutation
  have hp : (law.prod (independentSeedLaw nu)).map (Prod.map perm perm) =
      law.prod (independentSeedLaw nu) := by
    rw [← Measure.map_prod_map law (independentSeedLaw nu) hm hm]
    rw [hex permutation,actual_iid_seed_law_is_invariant_under_permutations nu permutation]
  have commute : permutedScores permutation ∘ attachSeeds = attachSeeds ∘ Prod.map perm perm := by
    funext data i
    rfl
  unfold actualSeededPairLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (actual_permuted_scores_are_measurable permutation) actual_attached_seed_pairs_are_measurable]
  rw [commute,← Measure.map_map actual_attached_seed_pairs_are_measurable (hm.prodMap hm),hp]

theorem actual_independent_atomless_seed_attachment_is_almost_surely_tie_free
    (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) (nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure law] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [NullSingletonClass nu] :
    ∀ᵐ pairs ∂actualSeededPairLaw law nu, Function.Injective pairs := by
  have hs := actual_all_independent_atomless_seed_coordinates_are_distinct (n := n) nu
  have joint : ∀ᵐ data ∂law.prod (independentSeedLaw nu), Function.Injective data.2 :=
    (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := law) (ν := independentSeedLaw nu)).ae hs
  have hp : MeasurableSet {pairs : Fin n → PairScore | Function.Injective pairs} := by
    have he : {pairs : Fin n → PairScore | Function.Injective pairs} =
        ⋂ i : Fin n, ⋂ j : Fin n, {pairs : Fin n → PairScore | pairs i = pairs j → i = j} := by
      ext pairs
      simp [Function.Injective]
    rw [he]
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro i
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp [hij]
    · have hc : MeasurableSet {pairs : Fin n → PairScore | ¬pairs i = pairs j} := by
        change MeasurableSet ({pairs : Fin n → PairScore | pairs i = pairs j}ᶜ)
        exact (measurableSet_eq_fun (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply j)).compl
      simpa only [hij,imp_false] using hc
  unfold actualSeededPairLaw
  apply (ae_map_iff actual_attached_seed_pairs_are_measurable.aemeasurable hp).2
  filter_upwards [joint] with data hd
  intro i j he
  apply hd
  exact congrArg Prod.snd he


instance actual_seeded_pair_law_probability (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure law] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (actualSeededPairLaw law nu) := by
  unfold actualSeededPairLaw
  infer_instance

theorem actual_lexicographic_joint_exchangeability_gives_every_rank_cdf
    (n : ℕ) (law : Measure (Fin (n+1) → PairScore)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : exchangeable law) (hties : ∀ᵐ scores ∂law, Function.Injective scores)
    (test : Fin (n+1)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    law.real {scores | rankNat scores test < k} = (k : ℝ)/(n+1) := by
  classical
  let top : Fin (n+1) := ⟨k,by omega⟩
  let ranks : Finset (Fin (n+1)) := Finset.Iio top
  have he : {scores | rankNat scores test < k} =
      ⋃ r ∈ ranks, rankEvent test r := by
    ext scores
    constructor
    · intro hs
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨rankFin scores test,Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨?_,?_⟩⟩
      · simpa [ranks,top,Fin.lt_def,rankFin] using hs
      · rfl
    · intro hs
      obtain ⟨r,hs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hs
      obtain ⟨hr,he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hs
      have hlt : r.val < k := by simpa [ranks,top,Fin.lt_def] using hr
      change rankNat scores test = r.val at he
      change rankNat scores test < k
      rw [he]
      exact hlt
  have hd : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑ranks) (rankEvent test) := by
    intro r hr s hs hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro scores h1 h2
    apply hne
    apply Fin.ext
    change rankNat scores test = r.val at h1
    change rankNat scores test = s.val at h2
    exact h1.symm.trans h2
  rw [he,measureReal_biUnion_finset hd (fun r _ => actual_rank_event_measurable test r)]
  simp_rw [actual_tie_free_exchangeable_rank_is_uniform law hex hties test]
  simp [ranks,top,Fin.card_Iio,div_eq_mul_inv]


def forgetSeeds (pairs : Fin n → PairScore) : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (pairs i).1

theorem actual_forgetting_independent_seeds_is_measurable : Measurable (forgetSeeds (n := n)) := by
  exact Measurable.of_eval (fun i => measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))

theorem actual_forgetting_independent_seeds_recovers_the_original_score_law
    (law : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) (nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure law] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] :
    (actualSeededPairLaw law nu).map forgetSeeds=law := by
  have he : forgetSeeds ∘ attachSeeds = (Prod.fst : (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ)) := by
    funext data i
    rfl
  unfold actualSeededPairLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map actual_forgetting_independent_seeds_is_measurable
    actual_attached_seed_pairs_are_measurable,he,Measure.map_fst_prod,measure_univ,one_smul]

theorem actual_original_strict_score_count_is_bounded_by_lexicographic_pair_count
    (pairs : Fin n → PairScore) (test : Fin n) :
    CompleteConformal.strictRank (forgetSeeds pairs) test ≤ rankNat pairs test := by
  classical
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro j hj
  refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j,?_⟩
  apply Prod.Lex.lt_iff.mpr
  exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2

theorem actual_small_lexicographic_rank_implies_original_calibration_membership
    (pairs : Fin n → PairScore) (test : Fin n) (k : ℕ)
    (h : rankNat pairs test < k) :
    ((forgetSeeds pairs) test : EReal) ≤ CompleteConformal.calibrationThreshold (forgetSeeds pairs) test k := by
  rw [←not_lt,CompleteConformal.calibration_failure_iff,not_le]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (actual_original_strict_score_count_is_bounded_by_lexicographic_pair_count pairs test) h

theorem actual_independent_uniform_seed_lexicographic_membership_has_exact_probability
    (n : ℕ) (law : Measure (Fin (n+1) → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure law]
    (hex : CompleteAppliedConformalRanks.exchangeable law)
    (test : Fin (n+1)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (actualSeededPairLaw law uniformUnitSeed).real {pairs | rankNat pairs test < k} = (k:ℝ)/(n+1) := by
  exact actual_lexicographic_joint_exchangeability_gives_every_rank_cdf n
    (actualSeededPairLaw law uniformUnitSeed)
    (actual_independent_seed_attachment_preserves_joint_exchangeability law uniformUnitSeed hex)
    (actual_independent_atomless_seed_attachment_is_almost_surely_tie_free law uniformUnitSeed)
    test k hk

theorem actual_independent_uniform_seed_construction_proves_the_tied_lower_coverage_bound

Exercise 15.3 — Prove the split-conformal coverage bound
      
      
        Let $s_1,\dots,s_n,s_{n+1}$ be exchangeable, almost surely distinct scores ($s_{n+1}$ is the test score) and $\hat q=s_{(k)}$ with $k=\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil\le n$. (a) Prove $\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)=k/(n+1)$. (b) Deduce $1-\alpha\le\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)\lt1-\alpha+\tfrac1{n+1}$. (c) For $n=9$, $\alpha=0.1$, what is $\hat q$ and what is the exact coverage? (d) Why does the lower bound survive ties while the upper bound may not?
        
          Show answer
          
            (a) Let $\rho$ be the rank of $s_{n+1}$ among the $n+1$ scores. Exchangeability means the joint law is invariant under permutations, so $\mathbb P(\rho=r)$ is the same for every $r\in\{1,\dots,n+1\}$, hence $1/(n+1)$. The event $s_{n+1}\le s_{(k)}$ (the $k$-th smallest of the other $n$ scores) means that at most $k-1$ of the others are smaller than $s_{n+1}$, i.e. $\rho\le k$. Therefore $\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)=\mathbb P(\rho\le k)=k/(n+1)$.
            (b) By definition of the ceiling, $(n+1)(1-\alpha)\le k\lt(n+1)(1-\alpha)+1$; divide by $n+1$.
            (c) $k=\lceil 10\cdot0.9\rceil=9$: $\hat q$ is the largest calibration score and the coverage is exactly $9/10=0.9$ (the prediction set is as tight as the guarantee allows, but only because $(n+1)(1-\alpha)$ is an integer; for $n=10$ one gets $k=\lceil9.9\rceil=10$ and coverage $10/11\approx0.909$).
            (d) With ties, attach an independent uniform tie-breaker $U_i$ to every score and order the pairs $(s_i,U_i)$ lexicographically. The pairs are exchangeable and almost surely distinct, so by (a) the rank $\rho$ of the test pair satisfies $\mathbb P(\rho\le k)=k/(n+1)$. If $\rho\le k$, at most $k-1$ calibration pairs precede the test pair, so at most $k-1$ calibration scores are strictly smaller than $s_{n+1}$ and $s_{n+1}\le s_{(k)}=\hat q$. Hence $\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)\ge k/(n+1)$: the lower bound is safe. The converse fails: a test score tied with $s_{(k)}$ is covered even when its tie-breaker ranks it after position $k$, and the probability can exceed $k/(n+1)$ by the mass of ties at $s_{(k)}$; the upper bound $1-\alpha+\tfrac1{n+1}$ therefore requires almost surely distinct joint scores (for example, independent and identically distributed continuous scores) or independent randomised tie-breaking for both calibration and test/prediction membership. In the extreme case of a constant score, $\mathcal C$ always contains everything and coverage is 1.

        Let $s_1,\dots,s_n,s_{n+1}$ be exchangeable, almost surely distinct scores ($s_{n+1}$ is the test score) and $\hat q=s_{(k)}$ with $k=\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil\le n$. (a) Prove $\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)=k/(n+1)$. (b) Deduce $1-\alpha\le\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)\lt1-\alpha+\tfrac1{n+1}$. (c) For $n=9$, $\alpha=0.1$, what is $\hat q$ and what is the exact coverage? (d) Why does the lower bound survive ties while the upper bound may not?
        
          Show answer
          
            (a) Let $\rho$ be the rank of $s_{n+1}$ among the $n+1$ scores. Exchangeability means the joint law is invariant under permutations, so $\mathbb P(\rho=r)$ is the same for every $r\in\{1,\dots,n+1\}$, hence $1/(n+1)$. The event $s_{n+1}\le s_{(k)}$ (the $k$-th smallest of the other $n$ scores) means that at most $k-1$ of the others are smaller than $s_{n+1}$, i.e. $\rho\le k$. Therefore $\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)=\mathbb P(\rho\le k)=k/(n+1)$.
            (b) By definition of the ceiling, $(n+1)(1-\alpha)\le k\lt(n+1)(1-\alpha)+1$; divide by $n+1$.
            (c) $k=\lceil 10\cdot0.9\rceil=9$: $\hat q$ is the largest calibration score and the coverage is exactly $9/10=0.9$ (the prediction set is as tight as the guarantee allows, but only because $(n+1)(1-\alpha)$ is an integer; for $n=10$ one gets $k=\lceil9.9\rceil=10$ and coverage $10/11\approx0.909$).
            (d) With ties, attach an independent uniform tie-breaker $U_i$ to every score and order the pairs $(s_i,U_i)$ lexicographically. The pairs are exchangeable and almost surely distinct, so by (a) the rank $\rho$ of the test pair satisfies $\mathbb P(\rho\le k)=k/(n+1)$. If $\rho\le k$, at most $k-1$ calibration pairs precede the test pair, so at most $k-1$ calibration scores are strictly smaller than $s_{n+1}$ and $s_{n+1}\le s_{(k)}=\hat q$. Hence $\mathbb P(s_{n+1}\le\hat q)\ge k/(n+1)$: the lower bound is safe. The converse fails: a test score tied with $s_{(k)}$ is covered even when its tie-breaker ranks it after position $k$, and the probability can exceed $k/(n+1)$ by the mass of ties at $s_{(k)}$; the upper bound $1-\alpha+\tfrac1{n+1}$ therefore requires a continuous score distribution or randomised tie-breaking in the prediction set itself. In the extreme case of a constant score, $\mathcal C$ always contains everything and coverage is 1.
